description: This file defines the 'UserService' interface which declares methods related to user management, including finding users by email or supervisor, saving users, retrieving all users, and getting maximum contract value for a user.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Interface for user management services, including CRUD operations and user-specific queries.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Returns a User object based on the provided email address.

methods.name: saveUser
methods.description: Persists the given User object to the database.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all User objects.

methods.name: findBySupervisor
methods.description: Finds Users that are supervised by the specified User.

methods.name: getMaxContractValue
methods.description: Calculates and returns the maximum contract value a User can accept based on their roles.
